issue_context.title: kubectl version should fail when given extra arguments
issue_context.body:
ran
```
kubectl version foocluster
```
instead of
```
kubectl version --context foocluster
```
and got no error and then though that was the right version
kubectl should fail for unexpected extra arguments

review_comments: Function signature might be changed according to it https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/9b09612d1b0a6ec441833f928cbb205d936da59c/staging/src/k8s.io/kubectl/pkg/cmd/apply/apply.go#L335

This is wrong place, this is causing tight coupling wit args, `Validate` is meant to ONLY to verify arguments of `Options` struct nothing outside. If you want to introduce such validation this should be done in `Complete` similarly to https://github.com/kubernetes/kubectl/blob/4da03973dd2fcd4645f20ac669d8a73cb017ff39/pkg/cmd/apiresources/apiversions.go#L72-L74

Thanks for the comments. If no object, I will submit another PR to fix it.
cc @eddiezane
